CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   D. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   D. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Abrahamic Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Abrahamic Covenant.
   C. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Abrahamic Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   D. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Lost Sheep? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Lost Sheep to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Lost Sheep.
   C. Say The Lost Sheep has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Lost Sheep with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.

10. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   B. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   C. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.
   C. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.
   B. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sacredness of Life 7 6.4 Bullying 7 6.5 Work: Talents and Abilities 7 6.6 Leisur and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sacredness of life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Bullying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
